questions.prompt: What is the recommended way to install LXD?
questions.explanation: Snap is the recommended installation method for LXD, ensuring you get the latest version.

questions.prompt: What command initializes LXD with default settings?
questions.explanation: lxd init --minimal sets up LXD with sensible defaults (storage pool, network bridge, no clustering).

questions.prompt: Why do you need to add your user to the lxd group?
options: To interact with the LXD daemon without sudo
questions.answer: To interact with the LXD daemon without sudo
questions.explanation: Membership in the lxd group grants access to the LXD Unix socket, which is how lxc talks to the daemon.

questions.prompt: What does lxc list show when LXD is freshly initialized?
questions.explanation: A freshly initialized LXD has no instances, so lxc list shows an empty table.
